title: Public stats and a machine-readable API spec
summary:
Public stats and an OpenAPI URL were added, while Polly, transaction history, and the community catalog got some practical tending.

A new read-only public stats endpoint exposes the community app directory with category and platform filters. Public stats also cover weekly app rankings and health data, while `/openapi.json` provides a single JSON spec for generation, account, and media storage APIs.

Polly now preserves `image_url` parts in OpenAI-format chat messages and renders Discord tables as images again. Its web fetching has a clearer fallback path, and repeated tool calls get guidance to stop searching and answer. CatGPT Bot also requests static Discord avatars so image requests are not handed an unexpected GIF.

Usage-history pagination now uses event IDs to distinguish records with identical timestamps. Transaction rows show API key names, and the activity page distinguishes UTC chart buckets from locally displayed transaction times.

daily.title: Explore public app stats
daily.text: Query the community app directory with category and platform filters, or inspect weekly app rankings and health stats through read-only public stats endpoints. [See the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.text: Get the JSON spec for generation, public account, and media storage APIs at `/openapi.json`, including code samples. [See the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
